name: @blotto/sanctions
description: Sanctions-list screening (Phase 2, published-claims register): one seam, a verdict type that carries list membership and never a risk score, and adapters for Chainalysis, a mirrored OFAC SDN list and OpenSanctions. Consumed by the packet service at entry and by the settlement daemon at resolving. Kept apart from @blotto/detection on purpose: a sanctions match shares nothing with the integrity-flag mechanism.
